test.template: Run the real test suite: execute `npm test` (or `npx vitest run` if npm test is unavailable) in the project root. Report pass/fail counts per test file, and fix any failing tests. If node_modules is missing, run `npm install` first.
test.description: Run the actual test suite (Vitest) and report results

lint.template: Run the real linter: execute `npm run lint` (or `npx eslint .` if unavailable) in the project root. Report all errors and warnings, then fix them. If no lint script exists, report the actual lint configuration found.
lint.description: Run the actual linter (ESLint) and fix issues

typecheck.template: Run the real type checker: execute `npm run typecheck` (or `npx tsc --noEmit` if unavailable) in the project root. Report all type errors and fix them. If no tsconfig exists, report that typecheck is not applicable.
typecheck.description: Run the actual TypeScript type checker
